prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Uranium (우라늄) itself — the sovereign of the Uranium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: early thirties — a poised, mature face with defined cheekbones and jaw; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: uranium: the heaviest natural element, forged in dying stars and hidden deep in the earth; dense and slowly decaying; uranium glass glowing eerie green, the blue Cherenkov glow of a reactor pool, yellowcake powder, the black-and-yellow trefoil of warning; immense power that must be contained. Palette: deep black, polished silver, uranium-glass emerald-green glow, a touch of Cherenkov blue.

World (fixed): year 2200, a reactor fortress: a deep cooling pool glowing Cherenkov blue, massive containment rings, hazard trefoils on lead-grey bulkheads. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Chosen original design:
Selected silhouette: several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt, legs visible between plates, no fabric. Signature construction: nested overlapping lead-shield-like black and polished-silver petal armor around the torso and hips, with narrow emerald-glass seam windows holding a contained reactor core; dense visible mechanical joints. Solid shoulder, forearm, chest, waist, thigh, shin and foot armor. Bold deliberate neckline and open upper-thigh intervals between hard plates while intimate areas remain covered. Pale ivory skin, short rounded oval adult face, clear amber almond eyes, restrained rose lip tint. Dark lead-grey hair with soft silver sheen, asymmetric chin-length bob with swept fringe. Calm approachable confidence. Both empty human hands visible at her sides, a small step forward. Year 2200 reactor fortress, deep blue cooling pool behind her and immense containment rings framing the far wall, emerald core light and one thin Cherenkov-blue waist ring. All skirt-like forms are rigid armor.

Costume colours (ours): deep black, polished silver, uranium-glass emerald-green glow, a touch of Cherenkov blue.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): dark lead-grey hair with a soft silver sheen. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (U) and atomic number (92) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original PNG preserved locally; WebP only in image repository.
